scientific_scope: exposed development/regression; not independent final holdout

species_family_topology.definition: Simple is the archived ILS family; Complex is the archived complex family. Pool records across taxon counts within each family; exclude incomplete runs.

concordtree_method: Current packaged bounded full-site AP-NJ -> MLP-NNI -> task refinement
comparator_measurements: DIPPER GPU runtime remeasured on 900 inputs; all historical comparator accuracy and other comparator runtimes preserved.

dipper_runtime_update.definition: PHYLIP-to-FASTA adapter time (including decompression for compressed inputs) plus synchronized native FASTA-file-to-tree time after CUDA EAGER initialization and TBB warmup
dipper_runtime_update.hardware: same Linux host, NVIDIA L40S GPU0 gene / GPU1 species, 16 NUMA-local logical CPUs per worker, no shared-GPU process concurrency
dipper_runtime_update.execution_model: CUDA/TBB-preinitialized fresh CLI process per input, not a retained DIPPER session
dipper_runtime_update.accuracy: Historical accuracy retained with its original source/tree/hash. Rerun accuracy is an independent downloadable check.
limitations: GPU-preinitialized fresh CLI process per record; not a retained DIPPER session benchmark
historical and new wall-time differences also reflect concurrency, affinity and host state, not a pure cold-start speedup
other comparator histories remain heterogeneous; no hardware-normalized universal speedup claim
